oxford.notes: Publisher page returned 403. Free PDF access is not verified redistribution permission.

cambridge-evp.notes: Reference only; no verified bulk redistribution grant.

leipzig.notes: Download page blocked by anti-bot challenge; exact corpus/package license not verified. No mirror licenses inferred.

p-pal.notes: Prior-conversation lead; package access/redistribution rights not verified.

lexmal-mlp.notes: Research/calibration lead; article access is not permission for the Malay Lexicon Project database. Dataset license not verified.

ud-ms.notes: No Malay treebank found in repository search on review date; Malayalam is a different language. Do not substitute Indonesian or Malayalam.
